# Default values for deploy.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

replicaCount: 1

production:
  enabled: false

uat:
  enabled: true

config:
  env:
    content: ""  # populated via --set-file
  secret:
    content: ""  # populated via --set-file

dbMigrate:
  enabled: true

image:
  repository: asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev/advisoryhub-ic1-uat-sk7g/ioh/cms/staging

  # Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.
  tag: "1.0.2"

imagePullSecrets: []
nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

backendConfig:
  requestPath: "/cms/login"

deployment:
  ports: 3000

serviceAccount:
  # Specifies whether a service account should be created
  create: true
  # Annotations to add to the service account
  annotations: {}
  # The name of the service account to use.
  # If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template
  name: ""

podAnnotations: {}

podSecurityContext: {}
  # fsGroup: 2000

securityContext: {}
  # capabilities:
  #   drop:
  #   - ALL
  # readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  # runAsNonRoot: true
  # runAsUser: 1000

service:
  type: NodePort
  port: 80
  nodePort: 30008

ingress:
  enabled: false
  className: ""
  annotations:
    # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
    # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
    kubernetes.io/ingress.global-static-ip-name: ext-addr-glb-ah-ic1-dev
    ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-cert: gammasprint
    ingress.gcp.kubernetes.io/pre-shared-cert: gammasprint
  hosts:
    - host: ide.gammasprint.com
      paths:
        - path: /bulky
          pathType: ImplementationSpecific
  tls: []

  #      - chart-example.local

resources:
  # We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious

  enabled: true
  minReplicas: 1

  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80

nodeSelector: {}

tolerations: []

affinity: {}

content.text:
Run this command to fix the deployment:

```bash
# First, uninstall the current release
helm uninstall ide-cms --namespace default --kubeconfig $KUBE_CONFIG_PATH

# Then reinstall with the same command from your pipeline
helm upgrade --install --debug ide-cms helm-rails/rails-service --version 0.4.6 --namespace default \
      --set image.tag=$COMMIT_HASH \
      --set externalSecrets.enabled=false \
      --set-file config.env.content=deploy/.env.uat.vars \
      --set-file config.secrets.content=deploy/.secret.uat.vars \
      --set dbMigrate.enabled=true \
      --set sidekiqWorker.enabled=true \
      -f deploy/uat-values.yaml \
      --kubeconfig $KUBE_CONFIG_PATH
```

The `helm uninstall` will remove the deployment with incompatible selectors, then `helm upgrade --install` will create a fresh deployment with correct labels.

# Production pipeline with optimizations
.prod-variables: &prod-variables
  KUBECONFIG: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.kube/config
  GCLOUD_PROJECT: advisoryhub-ic-prd-wt4b
  CLOUDSDK_COMPUTE_ZONE: asia-southeast2-a
  CLOUDSDK_CONTAINER_CLUSTER: gke-cl1-ic1-ah-prd
  TILLERLESS: "true"
  TILLER_NAMESPACE: default
  USE_GKE_GCLOUD_AUTH_PLUGIN: "true"
  GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/gcp-key.json
  KUBE_CONFIG_PATH: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.kube/config

.prod-rules: &prod-rules
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
  # for debugging
  # rules:
  # - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
  #   when: never
  # - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH =~ /(sit)\/.*/ && $CI_OPEN_MERGE_REQUESTS == null
  #   when: on_success
  # - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH =~ /(feature)\/.*/ && $CI_OPEN_MERGE_REQUESTS == null
  #   when: on_success

.rollback-rules: &rollback-rules
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG && $ROLLBACK == "true"

.prod-env: &prod-env
  environment:
    name: production

# Production Docker Build - optimized
prod-docker-build:
  image: docker:24.0.7
  stage: docker-build
  services:
    - name: docker:24.0.7-dind
      command: ["dockerd", "--host=tcp://0.0.0.0:2375", "--mtu=1460"]
  variables:
    DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2375
    DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: ""
    DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "1"  # Enable BuildKit for faster builds
  cache:
    key: "gcloud-kubectl-cache-v1"
    paths:
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/kubectl
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/
      - /var/cache/apk/
    policy: pull-push
    when: always
  before_script:
    # install curl for slack notifications
    - apk add --no-cache curl
    
    # slack notification - docker build starting
    - |
      curl -v -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
        --connect-timeout 10 \
        --max-time 30 \
        --retry 3 \
        --retry-delay 2 \
        --retry-connrefused \
        --data "{\"text\":\":building_construction: *Production Docker Build Starting*\\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
        $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack notification failed"

    - echo "Checking Docker daemon status..."
    - for i in $(seq 1 15); do docker info > /dev/null 2>&1 && break || (echo "Waiting for Docker daemon to start... ($i/15)" && sleep 1); done
    - docker info || (echo "Docker daemon failed to start" && exit 1)
    
    # setup buildx
    - docker buildx create --use --name mybuilder
    - docker buildx inspect --bootstrap
    
    # install gcloud CLI (Alpine method)
    - apk add --no-cache bash curl python3 py3-pip
    - curl -sSL https://sdk.cloud.google.com | bash
    - export PATH="$PATH:/root/google-cloud-sdk/bin"
    
    # gcloud setup
    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_DEVELOPMENT" > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json --account=$GCP_PROJECT_ID_DEVELOPMENT
    - gcloud auth configure-docker asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev
  script:
    # build and push to temporary tag
    - export COMMIT_HASH=${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}
    - docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg RAILS_ENV=production --build-arg RUBY_IMAGE=asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev/$GCP_PROJECT_ID_DEVELOPMENT/ioh/shared/ruby --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 -t asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev/$GCP_PROJECT_ID_DEVELOPMENT/ioh/cms:$COMMIT_HASH --push -f ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/Dockerfile ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}
  after_script:
    # install curl for slack notifications
    - apk add --no-cache curl
    
    # slack notification - docker build completed/failed
    - |
      if [ "$CI_JOB_STATUS" = "success" ]; then
        DEPLOY_JOB_ID=$((CI_JOB_ID + 1))
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":white_check_mark: *Production Docker Build Completed*\\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\\n:rocket: *Next Step:* Ready for manual deployment\\n:point_right: *Deploy Now:* <$CI_PROJECT_URL/-/jobs/$DEPLOY_JOB_ID|Click here to deploy>\\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack success notification failed"
      else
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":x: *Production Docker Build Failed*\\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack failure notification failed"
      fi
  <<: *prod-rules
  <<: *prod-env
  allow_failure: false
  tags:
    - docker-in-docker

# Production Deploy - optimized
prod-deploy:
  image: google/cloud-sdk:alpine
  stage: deploy
  variables:
    <<: *prod-variables
  cache:
    key: "gcloud-kubectl-helm-cache-v1"
    paths:
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/kubectl
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/
      - /usr/bin/helm
      - /var/cache/apk/
    policy: pull-push
    when: always
  before_script:    
    # install curl for slack notifications
    - apk add --no-cache curl
    
    # construct commit hash first
    - export COMMIT_HASH=${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}
    - export TAG_VERSION=${CI_COMMIT_TAG}
    
    # slack notification - deployment awaiting manual approval
    - |
      curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
        --data "{\"text\":\":rocket: *Production Deployment Ready - Manual Approval Required*\\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\\n:hash: *Commit:* $COMMIT_HASH\\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\\n:warning: *Action Required:* Please approve deployment manually\\n:point_right: *Deploy Now:* <$CI_PROJECT_URL/-/jobs/$CI_JOB_ID|Click here to approve and deploy>\\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
        $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack notification failed"

    # gcloud setup
    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_PRODUCTION" | base64 -d > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json
    - gcloud components install gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
    - gcloud container clusters get-credentials $GKE_CLUSTER_NAME_PRODUCTION --zone $GKE_ZONE_PRODUCTION --project $GKE_PROJECT_ID_PRODUCTION --internal-ip
    - gcloud auth configure-docker asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev

    # install helm
    - apk add --no-cache helm

    # setup helm rails-service repo
    - helm repo add --username helm-rails --password $GITLAB_DEPLOY_TOKEN_PASSWORD helm-rails http://mygitlab-dev.ioh.co.id/api/v4/projects/61/packages/helm/stable
    - helm repo update
  script:
    - echo "Deploying to Production"
    - |
      helm upgrade --install --debug ide-cms helm-rails/rails-service --version 0.4.6 --namespace default \
        --set image.tag=$COMMIT_HASH \
        --set externalSecrets.enabled=false \
        --set-file config.env.content=deployment/.env.prod.vars \
        --set-file config.secret.content=deployment/.secret.prod.vars \
        --set dbMigrate.enabled=true \
        --set sidekiqWorker.enabled=true \
        -f deployment/prod-values.yaml \
        --kubeconfig $KUBE_CONFIG_PATH --kube-insecure-skip-tls-verify
  after_script:
    # install curl for slack notifications
    - apk add --no-cache curl
    
    # slack notification - deployment completed/failed
    - |
      if [ "$CI_JOB_STATUS" = "success" ]; then
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":white_check_mark: *Production Deployment Completed Successfully*\\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack success notification failed"
      else
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":x: *Production Deployment Failed*\\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack failure notification failed"
      fi
  <<: *prod-rules
  <<: *prod-env
  when: manual
  allow_failure: false
  tags:
    - ide-prod

# Rollback approval
rollback-approval:
  stage: rollback-approval
  script:
    - 'echo "Rollback approved for tag: $CI_COMMIT_TAG"'
    - 'echo "Previous deployment will be rolled back"'
  <<: *rollback-rules
  <<: *prod-env
  when: manual
  needs:
    - prod-deploy

# Rollback deploy - optimized
rollback-deploy:
  image: google/cloud-sdk:alpine
  stage: rollback
  variables:
    <<: *prod-variables
  before_script:    
    # gcloud setup
    - '[ -z "$GCP_SA_KEY_PROD" ] && echo "ERROR: GCP_SA_KEY_PROD variable is not set or empty. Please check your GitLab CI/CD settings." && exit 1'
    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_PROD" | base64 -d > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json
    - gcloud components install gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
    - gcloud container clusters get-credentials $GKE_CLUSTER_NAME_PROD --zone $GKE_ZONE --project $GKE_PROJECT_ID_PROD --internal-ip

    # install helm
    - apk add --no-cache helm

    # setup helm rails-service repo
    - helm repo add --username helm-rails --password $GITLAB_DEPLOY_TOKEN_PASSWORD helm-rails http://mygitlab-dev.ioh.co.id/api/v4/projects/61/packages/helm/stable
    - helm repo update
  script:
    - echo "Rolling back deployment"
    - |
      helm rollback ide-cms --namespace default --kubeconfig $KUBE_CONFIG_PATH
    - echo "Rollback completed successfully"
  <<: *rollback-rules
  <<: *prod-env
  allow_failure: false
  tags:
    - docker-in-docker
  needs:
    - rollback-approval
